entries.what: Caught the 7:02 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then went to MWF classes at Bayshore State's Tamsen campus.
Joined the regional case competition team of four after class and heard the Nov 8 date at Bayshore.
entries.outcome: Officially on the case team, one more commitment on the pile.

entries.what: Worked his career center front desk shift, then rode home and updated the spreadsheet.
At Marisol Gardens, Marcus mentioned his mom Denise's drugstore hours were cut to 24 a week, and he would send more money home.
entries.outcome: Arjun said little but noted Marcus was worried.

entries.what: Taped a quiet-hours note on his door so Marcus could sleep after night shift, then left for the 7:02.
entries.outcome: Apartment stays quieter through the morning.

entries.what: Tuesday operations management with Dr. Ashby at 10:30, then worked on the tote-flow group project.
Used the lunch break to send alum outreach messages for his one-a-weekday goal.
Stayed up past 1 a.m. tweaking his resume at his desk.
entries.outcome: Resume v14 got another small edit.

entries.what: MWF classes at Bayshore, 9 to 12, with the 7:02 train in.
Met the case team in a library study room to split research tasks for the case comp.
entries.outcome: Got assigned the logistics cost model.

entries.what: Ate meal-prepped rajma and rice, then spent the evening on applications.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet grew by a few rows.

entries.what: Tuesday/Thursday ops class, then went to Dr. Ashby's 2-3:30 office hours to ask about the course project.
entries.outcome: Got a short answer and stayed professional.

entries.what: Sat next to Priya at a case team meeting and noticed he kept losing his train of thought.
Did laundry at the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room Thursday night.
Took the 7:02 in, attended afternoon career center desk hours, and saw Omar's post about securing a summer internship at a freight brokerage.
entries.outcome: Scrolled past, then back to it.

entries.what: Went home and ate leftovers while Marcus got ready for his night shift.
entries.outcome: Short chat, then he left for Ridgeline.

entries.what: Worked on applications until after midnight.
Ran the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about four miles, in the morning.
Asked how competitive freight brokerage internships are the day after Omar posted his offer, and privately thought it came through his uncle.
Walked through the Calle Ortega Street Fair for lunch and passed his mom's tax-prep office.
Spent the evening on case comp cost model work.
Meal-prepped four containers of rajma and rice.
Ate Sunday dinner at his parents' Pell Road house and came home with a tub of dal.
entries.outcome: Got the usual questions about internships.

entries.what: Took his mother's Sunday evening call about the internship search.
entries.outcome: Told her about the case team and Omar's news.

entries.what: Planned the week in the spreadsheet and went to bed around 1:30.
